oneLiner: A web-based decision log that records what was decided, why, and when.
problem: Teams lose context and accountability for decisions, causing repeated discussions, misaligned actions, and difficulty tracing rationale.
targetUser: Project managers, product owners, and cross‑functional teams who need a single source of truth for decisions.
coreFlow: Enter decision details, rationale, and date
Save and view in Decision History

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Overview of recent decisions, quick actions, and activity metrics.

screens.name: Decision Entry
screens.purpose: Form to capture what was decided, why, when, and who was involved.

screens.name: Decision Detail
screens.purpose: Full view of a single decision with rationale, discussion notes, and audit trail.

screens.name: Search & Filter
screens.purpose: Find decisions by keywords, tags, dates, or participants.

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: Configure team members, permissions, export options, and branding.

outOfScope: Deep integrations with external PM tools
